prompt_text: Who is the best AI marketing agency in Los Angeles?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” AI marketing agency in Los Angeles — the right choice depends on your goals, budget, industry and KPIs. I can help you pick the best fit. A few quick questions to start:

- What do you want AI to solve (media buying optimization, creative/content generation, personalization, email/subject-line optimization, analytics/attribution, chatbots, etc.)?
- What’s your monthly/annual budget for the engagement?
- Company size and vertical (startup, DTC, entertainment, B2B, e‑commerce)?
- Do you need a full-service agency or a platform/integration partner?
- Timeline and success metrics (ROAS, CPA, LTV, conversions, engagement)?

If you want to evaluate agencies yourself, prioritize these criteria:
- Proven case studies and measurable results in your vertical
- Clear explanation of the AI techniques used (not just “AI” buzzwords)
- Data access, integration and privacy practices
- Team mix (data scientists + engineers + marketers + creatives)
- Technology stack and integrations with your martech (CDP, CRM, ad platforms)
- Governance/guardrails (how models are validated, updated, and audited)
- Pricing model and expected ROI; references you can contact

Some widely used AI-driven vendors and agencies active in the LA market you can consider investigating (verify coverage and case studies for your use case):
- Cognitiv — programmatic media using deep‑learning models
- Albert — autonomous digital media buying platform
- Persado — AI for message and language optimization (email/ads)
- Cortex / Pattern89 (now part of Shutterstock) — creative optimization and predictive creative insights
- Large consultancies / digital agencies with AI practices (Accenture Interactive, Deloitte Digital, PwC) — for enterprise integrations and data science

Next steps I can do for you:
- Build a tailored shortlist (3–5 agencies) based on your answers above
- Draft an RFP or a short questionnaire to send to agencies
- Provide a vendor comparison template with scoring criteria

Tell me your goals and constraints and I’ll make a targeted recommendation.
